Package dev.relism.flash.ext.view.jte

Class JteModule

java.lang.Object
dev.relism.flash.ext.view.core.ViewModule
dev.relism.flash.ext.view.jte.JteModule
All Implemented Interfaces:
Module
public final class JteModule extends ViewModule
jte templates for ViewHandlers named with Template, rendered straight to UTF-8 bytes, and the classpath's static/ directory served under /static. Templates are compiled at build time outside dev and on the fly in dev. 

 app.install(new JteModule().global("user", req -> currentUser(req)));
